The prize money on "$2,000,000 Bonus Scratch Multiplier" leans toward small, frequent prizes. It is spread over nine prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $2 million. Games built like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

Today's free summary of "$2,000,000 Bonus Scratch Multiplier" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
